The answer is **Madrid**: Real Madrid was a founding member of La Liga in 1929, and early in its history it reportedly tried a black shirt and shorts, though its identity became the all-white kit ([Goal](https://www.goal.com/en/news/why-do-real-madrid-wear-white-la-liga-giants-kit-colour-history-explained/blt3bcff820367bc5f5)). My searches did not confirm a sustained white-and-black kit for any founder, so the kit clue is the weak part of this answer.

CONFIDENCE: 60
